concept.hr: Jedna adresa na više mjesta; BGP bira najbliže
concept.en: One address, many places; BGP picks the nearest

summary.hr: Tri PoP-a najavljuju isti prefiks; svaki AS ide na kraj svog najboljeg BGP puta. Povuci PoP, prekini vezu ili promijeni lokalnu prednost.
summary.en: Three PoPs announce one prefix; each AS goes to the end of its best BGP path. Withdraw a PoP, fail a link or change a local preference.
